# QHEFermionsOverlap

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/QHEFermionsOverlap`

```text
QHEFermionsOverlap, version 0.01

Usage: QHEFermionsOverlap [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 7)
    -l, --lzmax : twice the maximum momentum for a single particle (default value = 12)
    --lz : twice the momentum projection (default value = 0)
    --exact-state : name of the file containing the vector obtained using exact diagonalization
    --pfaffian-as-exact : use Moore-Read Pfaffian instead of exact state
    --list-wavefunctions : list all available test wave fuctions
    --use-exact : file name of an exact state that has to be used as test wave function

analytical wave function options:
    --test-wavefunction : name of the test wave fuction
    --nbr-flux : number of quantum flux attached to each particle (laughlin and *cf only) (value must be greater than 0, default value = 1)
    --cluster-size : number of particles per cluster (read only) (value must be greater than 2, default value = 3)
    --nbr-level : number of pseudo Landau levels (filledcf only) (value must be greater than 1, default value = 1)
    --cf-file : name of the file describing the composite fermion state (genericcf only)
    --MR-coeff : coefficient for Moore-Read contribution (pairedcf only) (default value = 1)
    --pair-coeff : sequence of pairing coefficients (pairedcf only)
    --pair-compatibility : adopt old conventions for normalisation (pairedcf only)
    --fermion-state : generate a fermionic wavefunction (RR)
    --CF-levels : number of CF levels to fill (><0) (SLBS) (default value = -2)
    --Jz-Value : Total angular momentum Jz (hund only) (default value = 0)
    --hund-L2 : Total angular momentum J if less than maximal (hund only) (default value = -1)
    --JM-Values : Angular momentum J and projection on z axis J,M (paired2QH only)
    --QHMC-iter : Number of MC steps for internal MC (paired2QH only) (default value = 1000)

product state options:
    --product-state : Use the product state interface
    --first-state : file name of the first wave function
    --first-boson : Use a polarized bosonic basis for first reference state
    --first-lzmax : total number of flux quanta (0 if it has to be guessed from input file name) (default value = 0)
    --first-lz : twice the total lz value of the polarized vector(s) (0 if it has to be guessed from input file name) (default value = 0)
    --second-state : file name of the second wave function (optional)
    --second-boson : Use a polarized bosonic basis for first reference state
    --second-lzmax : total number of flux quanta (0 if it has to be guessed from input file name) (default value = 0)
    --second-lz : twice the total lz value of the polarized vector(s) (0 if it has to be guessed from input file name) (default value = 0)
    --min-parallel : minimum dimension of polarized space before parallel evaluation is applied (default value = 5000)
    --jastrow-power : powers of Jastrow factors to be added (can be negative) (default value = 0)

Monte Carlo options:
    -i, --nbr-iter : number of Monte Carlo iterations (default value = 10000)
    -t, --nbr-warmup-iter : number of steps for thermalization (default value = 500)
    --display-step : number of iteration between two consecutive result displays (default value = 1000)
    --randomSeed : value of random seed to be used (default value = 29457)
    -H, --history-mode : use on-file history: (0=off, 1=generate new, 2=read history, 3=optimize with history, 4=continue to generate given history) (default value = 1)
    --history-file : name of the file where overlap recording has to be done
    --varyMR : vary coefficient of 1/z in pair wavefunction
    -d, --sample-density : spacing of samples to be saved in History-mode (default value = 1)
    --linearPoints : number of function evaluations along the gradient in optimising History mode  (default value = 25)
    --randomPoints : number of random function evaluations in optimising History mode  (default value = 0)
    --limitSamples : maximal number of samples to be used from history-file (default value = 10000000)
    --record-step : number of iterations between two consecutive result recording the overlap value (0 if no on-disk recording is needed) (default value = 0)
    --record-file : name of the file where overlap recording has to be done
    --with-timecoherence : use time coherence between two successive evaluation of the wave function
    --random-file : name of the file where random number to use are stored (use internal random generator if no file name is provided)
    --random-seek : if usage of a random number file is activiated, jump the first random numbers up to the seek position (default value = 0)
    --show-details : show intermediate values used for overlap calculation

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

misc options:
    --write-grid : output wave function on grid points
    --write-random : output wave function on random points
    --max-grid : number of grid points in each direction (default value = 10)
    --test : test Monte Carlo observable (default value = 0)
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
